TYCS
Practical No. 3
STLC Implementation: Test Plan, Manual Execution, Test Report & Defect
Tracking
Aim
To prepare a Test Plan, Test Scenarios, and Test Cases for a given web application using MS
Excel / Google Sheets, manually execute the test cases, compare the actual results with the
expected results, and prepare a Test Execution Report and Defect Report according to the
Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) process.
Tool Used
MS Excel / Google Sheets
Application Under Test
Application Name: Sauce Demo
Application Type: E-commerce Web Application
URL: https://www.saucedemo.com/
Introduction
Manual testing is a software testing technique in which test cases are executed by a tester
manually without using automation tools or scripts. The tester interacts with the application,
enters test data, performs different operations, observes the output, and compares the actual
result with the expected result.
In this practical, the Sauce Demo web application is selected for manual functional testing.
Different functionalities such as login, product display, adding products to the cart, removing
products, checkout, order completion, and logout are tested.
The test documentation is prepared using MS Excel / Google Sheets. The testing process
follows the major phases of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
